documents.title: Listing Approval From BSE Limited & National Stock Exchange Of India Limited For 15,01,434 Equity Shares Of Rs 2/- Each Under Preferential Basis.
Fixation Of Book Closure Dates For The 41St AGM

analysis.summary: Bhagyanagar India Limited reported a revenue of over 700 crores and sales volumes of 5,200 tons for Q1 FY27. The company achieved its highest EBITDA margin of recent times at 5.43% and its highest EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees. Management proposed a capex of 40 crores over the next two years (FY27 and FY28) and is planning a corporate restructuring to form Tieramet Limited. The company is targeting a long-term revenue of 5,000 crores by FY30. Bhagyanagar India Limited presented its investor presentation for Q1FY27, reporting operational revenue of Rs.

guidance.claim: The company expects volume growth of 12% to 15% for the full year.
guidance.quote: So, | think we should be looking at between 12% to 15% growth in terms of volume for the whole year now.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of achieving 5,000 crores of revenue by FY30.
guidance.quote: But we are very confident of 5,000 crores by FY30, whatever the copper price.

guidance.claim: The company hopes to maintain its EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5% going forward in the year.
guidance.quote: Going forward in the year, we hope to maintain the EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5%.

guidance.claim: The company targets an export contribution of 12% to 15% for the year.
guidance.quote: 12-15% would be a good estimate for the year.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting a 25% CAGR for the next 3 to 4 years.
guidance.quote: 25% CAGR is our target for the next 3 to 4 years.

guidance.claim: The company is hopeful of maintaining a 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year.
guidance.quote: We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year, and on an increased top line.

guidance.claim: The company expects 20% volume growth and a 5% increase in prices out of its growth target.
guidance.quote: Out of the 25%, we are expecting 20% volume growth and 5% increase in prices.

guidance.claim: The company expects its minimum volume growth to be between 15% to 20% every year.
guidance.quote: Between 15% to 20% should be our volume growth minimum every year.

guidance.claim: The company plans to increase its share of value-added products to 66% by the end of next year.
guidance.quote: So, we've already reached around 62% at the end of quarter four, and we are planning to get this up to 66% by the end of next year.

demand_outlook.claim: Secondary copper demand in India is expected to double from 0.7 million metric tons to 1.4 million metric tons in the next 5 years.
demand_outlook.quote: Out of this, if you look at the secondary copper demand, it is expected to double in the next 5 years, from 0.7 million metric tons to 1.4 million metric tons.

demand_outlook.claim: The company sees strong demand, with existing customers looking to increase volumes and double capacity in the next 3 years.
demand_outlook.quote: As of today, we see a lot of demand. All our customers are looking to increase their volumes and everybody is talking about doubling their capacity in the next 3 years.

demand_outlook.claim: Growing sustainability focus and supply constraints are accelerating the transition from primary to recycled copper in India.
demand_outlook.quote: Growing sustainability focus and supply constraints are accelerating the transition from primary to recycled copper in India.

demand_outlook.claim: World copper consumption is predicted to reach 50 million tonnes by 2050.
demand_outlook.quote: The world consumed around 26 million tonne of copper, which is predicted to become 50 million tonne by 2050, so this is almost doubling.

demand_outlook.claim: India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.
demand_outlook.quote: India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.

demand_outlook.claim: Copper demand growth will be driven by EV and automotive, power and electrification, and renewable energy.
demand_outlook.quote: This growth will mainly be driven by three sectors, EV and automotive. Because, EV requires a lot more copper than regular cars, power and electrification is also a big growth factor, and renewable energy.

demand_outlook.claim: The company foresees a big copper shortage coming after 3 or 4 years.
demand_outlook.quote: The availability, while right now there is no shortage for the next 2 or 3 years for copper. But we foresee a big shortage coming after 3 or 4 years.

capex_expansion.claim: The management has proposed 40 crores of capex over the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is forming a new wholly owned subsidiary called Tieramet Limited to restructure its businesses.
capex_expansion.quote: We are going to form a new company called Tieramet Limited, which will be a wholly owned subsidiary of Bhagyanagar India.

capex_expansion.claim: Bhagyanagar India Limited stated that a capacity expansion is currently underway.
The company is proposing about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.
capex_expansion.quote: We are proposing about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.
capex_expansion.quote: And over here, as mentioned, we are planning to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to invest around 10 crores into plastic recycling.
capex_expansion.quote: So, right now, we are planning to invest around 10 crores into plastic recycling, where the cable waste comes in, we process them into different grades, we make granules, and with aluminium and other metals, we make ingots, and then we put them back into the supply chain.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is adding recycling verticals for aluminium and plastic.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are also adding recycling verticals of aluminium and plastic.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved its highest EBITDA margin of recent times at 5.43% and highest PAT margin of 2.87% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: We have had our highest EBITDA margin of recent times at 5.43%, our highest PAT margin of 2.87%.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved its highest EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees in the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: We have also had our highest share of value-added products sold this quarter, which is 63% and our highest EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees.

margins_costs.claim: The company increased its margins in the first two months of the quarter by taking advantage of trade route disruptions and material shortages.
margins_costs.quote: In the first two months, because of the disruption of all the trade routes and the shortage of material all over the country, while the turnover came down, we could take advantage of the situation by increasing our margins.

margins_costs.claim: Bhagyanagar India Limited reported EBITDA per kg of INR 72.55 in Q1FY27 compared to INR 28.68 in Q1FY26.
The company recorded an EBITDA margin of 5.43% for Q1FY27.
The company's margins have increased significantly since shifting focus to value-added products.
margins_costs.quote: So, since we have made a shift in our mindset of going into value-added products, our margins have increased a lot.

margins_costs.claim: The company's EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees, which is very high compared to our peers, and as you can see, over the four quarters, our EBITDA per kg has been trending upwards.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved around 62 rupees per kg EBITDA in quarter four.
margins_costs.quote: With the quarter four, we achieved around 62 rupees per kg.

margins_costs.claim: The company has a pass-through mechanism for copper prices to finished products.
margins_costs.quote: We have a pass-through mechanism of the copper prices to the finished products.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has finished adding its capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is now online.
orders_capacity.quote: We have also finished adding our capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is online now.

orders_capacity.claim: The company plans to increase its CTC wires capacity from roughly 80 metric tons a month to 150 metric tons a month.
orders_capacity.quote: On CTC wires, our capacity is roughly about 80 metric tons a month and we will be going up to 150 metric tons a month.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved sales volumes of 5,200 tons in the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: We have achieved sales volumes of 5,200 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: Bhagyanagar India Limited achieved a sales volume of 5,278 MT in Q1FY27.
The company's capacity reached 35,000 metric tonnes this year with a new 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.
orders_capacity.quote: Our capacity has now reached 35,000 metric tonne this year, with the new, 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates two ISO-certified manufacturing plants.
orders_capacity.quote: We have two ISO-certified manufacturing plants, and pan-India customer base across all sectors, and also in exports.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's copper sales volume grew 34% to 24,000 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Last year, we did around 18,000 metric tonne of volume of copper sales. Which has gone up by 34% to, 2 24,000 metric tonne.

capital_allocation.claim: The company finalized its first round of fundraising at 52 crores, with funds expected in August.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we have just finalized the first round of raising, at 52 crores, which is finalized, and the money should be in the bank in the month of August.

capital_allocation.claim: The company expects its debt to be around 325 crores in 2030.
capital_allocation.quote: The projection is showing that around 325 crores will be the debt in 2030.

capital_allocation.claim: The second tranche of fundraising will probably occur around March in the standalone copper unit.
capital_allocation.quote: The second tranche will probably be around March, after the demerger is done, in the standalone copper unit.

capital_allocation.claim: The company proposed a total fund raise of Rs. 52.25 Crores through a preferential issue.
The company's working capital increased from 157 crores to 230 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our working capital has gone up from 157 crores to 230 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's increase in equity was achieved through retained earnings.
capital_allocation.quote: And this increase in equity was not done through dilution, this was all done through retained earnings.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's working capital and borrowings will increase along with turnover.
capital_allocation.quote: Our working capital will keep going up along with the turnover, and our borrowings also will go up, but hopefully not in the same ratio as our turnover.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced a GST case due to the retrospective cancellation of a supplier's registration.
risks_headwinds.quote: Because of the retrospective cancellation of the registration of the supplier, the case has been put on us.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company expects competitive pressures to persist over time.
risks_headwinds.quote: But we have to understand that there will always be competitive pressures all around us as time flies.

risks_headwinds.claim: Higher copper prices will require more funds to cover the margin for MCX hedging.
risks_headwinds.quote: As the copper prices go up, we will require more and more money to fund the margin for MCX.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sourcing from Gulf has decreased and sourcing from other countries has slowed down due to transshipment issues.
risks_headwinds.quote: Whatever sourcing from Gulf has come down. Sourcing from other countries has slowed down because of transshipment in and around Gulf.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's volume in the first quarter might be marginally lower than the fourth quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: My volume in the first quarter might be marginally lower than fourth quarter.

management_commitments.claim: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to execute a complete digital transformation over the next year.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next year, we are going to do a complete digital transformation of our company, where every process, every department and all reporting will be completely digitalized automatically, and no manual entry would be required.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to reach a value-added percentage of between 63% and 64% for the current year.
management_commitments.quote: In terms of our value-added percentage, we are looking at between 63% and 64% for this year.

management_commitments.claim: Government regulations mandate that all new non-ferrous metal products must contain a minimum of 5% recycled content starting from FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Government has mandated that all new products made from non-ferrous metals must contain a minimum of 5% recycled content (starting from FY28)

management_commitments.claim: The company is proposing about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: We are proposing about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.
management_commitments.quote: And over here, as mentioned, we are planning to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.

management_commitments.claim: The company is hopeful of maintaining a 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year.
management_commitments.quote: We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year, and on an increased top line.

management_commitments.claim: The company hopes to execute its fundraise in this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We hope to do it in this financial year, definitely.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
